| `maxParticles` | `int?` | no | `null` | Hard cap on live particles |

```json
{ "target": "Fire", "rateOverTime": 40, "startLifetime": 2.5 }
```

### `vfx.info`

Read a VisualEffect component: its asset, its exposed parameters and their current values.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | no | `null` | GameObject with a VisualEffect component. Omit to list them all. |

```json
{ "target": "Sparks" }
```

### `vfx.set`

Set one exposed parameter on a VisualEffect: float, int, bool, Vector2/3/4 or colour.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | GameObject with a VisualEffect component |
| `parameter` | `string` | yes | — | Exposed parameter name, exactly as the graph publishes it |
| `value` | `float?` | no | `null` | Numeric value, for float, int or bool parameters |
| `vector` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Vector or colour value, 2-4 numbers |

```json
{ "target": "Sparks", "parameter": "Rate", "value": 250 }
```

## gameobject

| Tool | Mutating | Undo | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gameobject.create` | yes | Create GameObject | Create a GameObject in the active scene. |
| `gameobject.delete` | yes | Delete GameObject | Delete a GameObject and its children. |
| `gameobject.duplicate` | yes | Duplicate GameObject | Duplicate a GameObject in place. |
| `gameobject.find` | no | n/a | Find GameObjects by name, tag, layer or component. Bounded output. |
| `gameobject.get` | no | n/a | Read one GameObject: identity, transform and component names. |
| `gameobject.rename` | yes | Rename GameObject | Rename a GameObject. |
| `gameobject.setActive` | yes | Set Active | Activate or deactivate a GameObject. |
| `gameobject.setLayer` | yes | Set Layer | Set a GameObject's layer, optionally recursively. |
| `gameobject.setParent` | yes | Set Parent | Reparent a GameObject. |
| `gameobject.setTag` | yes | Set Tag | Set a GameObject's tag. |
| `setup.thirdPersonController` | yes | Set up third-person controller | Create a third-person controller: character, camera rig and movement script. Two calls — the first writes the script, the second builds the rig after the reload. |

### `gameobject.create`

Create a GameObject in the active scene.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | — | Name of the new GameObject |
| `primitive` | `string` | no | `null` | Primitive type: Cube, Sphere, Capsule, Cylinder, Plane, Quad. Omit for an empty GameObject. |
| `parent` | `string` | no | `null` | Parent path or #instanceId |
| `position` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Local position as [x, y, z] |
| `rotation` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Local euler angles as [x, y, z] |
| `scale` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Local scale as [x, y, z] |

```json
{ "name": "Enemy", "primitive": "Capsule", "parent": "Spawns" }
```

```json
{ "name": "Empty" }
```

### `gameobject.delete`

Delete a GameObject and its children.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |

```json
{ "target": "Enemy" }
```

### `gameobject.duplicate`

Duplicate a GameObject in place.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `name` | `string` | no | `null` | Name for the copy. Defaults to Unity's naming. |

```json
{ "target": "Crate", "name": "Crate (2)" }
```

### `gameobject.find`

Find GameObjects by name, tag, layer or component. Bounded output.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | `null` | Exact or substring name match |
| `tag` | `string` | no | `null` | Tag filter |
| `layer` | `string` | no | `null` | Layer name filter |
| `component` | `string` | no | `null` | Component type name filter, e.g. Rigidbody |
| `contains` | `bool` | no | `true` | Substring rather than exact name match |
| `includeInactive` | `bool` | no | `true` | Include inactive GameObjects |
| `limit` | `int` | no | `100` | Maximum results (default 100) |
| `offset` | `int` | no | `0` | Skip this many results |

```json
{ "name": "Enemy", "limit": 20 }
```

```json
{ "component": "Rigidbody", "includeInactive": false }
```

### `gameobject.get`

Read one GameObject: identity, transform and component names.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `children` | `bool` | no | `false` | Include the names of direct children |

```json
{ "target": "Player" }
```

### `gameobject.rename`

Rename a GameObject.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `name` | `string` | yes | — | New name |


### `gameobject.setActive`

Activate or deactivate a GameObject.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `active` | `bool` | yes | — | Desired active state |

```json
{ "target": "Enemy", "active": false }
```

### `gameobject.setLayer`

Set a GameObject's layer, optionally recursively.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `layer` | `string` | yes | — | Layer name or index |
| `recursive` | `bool` | no | `false` | Apply to all descendants too |

```json
{ "target": "Level", "layer": "Default", "recursive": true }
```

### `gameobject.setParent`

Reparent a GameObject.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `parent` | `string` | no | `null` | New parent path, or null to move to the scene root |

```json

```


### `gameobject.setTag`

Set a GameObject's tag.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |


### `setup.thirdPersonController`

Create a third-person controller: character, camera rig and movement script. Two calls — the first writes the script, the second builds the rig after the reload.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | no | `"Player"` | Name for the character object |
| `position` | `float[]` | no | `null` | World position [x, y, z] (default [0, 1, 0]) |
| `moveSpeed` | `float` | no | `4f` | Walk speed in m/s (default 4) |
| `sprintSpeed` | `float` | no | `7f` | Sprint speed in m/s (default 7) |
| `jumpHeight` | `float` | no | `1.2f` | Jump height in metres (default 1.2) |
| `scriptFolder` | `string` | no | `"Assets/Scripts/Generated"` | Where the generated script goes |

```json
{ "name": "Player" }
```

```json
{ "name": "Player", "position": [0, 1, 0], "moveSpeed": 6 }
```

| Tool | Mutating | Undo | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scene.children` | no | n/a | List the children of a GameObject, to a bounded depth. |

Select GameObjects from the scene hierarchy with a path selector and return only the fields you ask for.

| `space` | `string` | no | `"local"` | "local" or "world" |

```json
{ "target": "Crate", "euler": [0, 90, 0] }
```

### `transform.set`

Set position, rotation and/or scale on a GameObject.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `position` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Position as [x, y, z] |
| `rotation` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Euler angles as [x, y, z] |
| `scale` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Scale as [x, y, z] (always local) |
| `space` | `string` | no | `"local"` | "local" or "world" for position/rotation |

```json
{ "target": "Crate", "position": [0, 1, 0], "space": "local" }
```

```json
{ "target": "Crate", "scale": [2, 2, 2] }
```

### `transform.translate`

Move a GameObject by a delta.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | `string` | yes | — | Path, name or #instanceId |
| `delta` | `float[]` | yes | — | Delta as [x, y, z] |
| `space` | `string` | no | `"local"` | "local" or "world" |

```json
{ "target": "Crate", "delta": [0, 0.5, 0] }
```

## ui

| Tool | Mutating | Undo | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `setup.uiScreen` | yes | Set up UI screen | Create a working UI screen: canvas, scaler, raycaster, EventSystem if missing, a root panel, and the elements you name. |
| `ui.layoutReport` | no | n/a | Geometric UI problems on a canvas: off-screen rects, zero-size elements, overlapping siblings, low-contrast text, unsafe-area content. |

### `setup.uiScreen`

Create a working UI screen: canvas, scaler, raycaster, EventSystem if missing, a root panel, and the elements you name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | — | Screen name; the canvas takes it |
| `elements` | `string[]` | no | `null` | Elements, each "kind:Label" where kind is text, button, image or panel |
| `referenceResolution` | `float[]` | no | `null` | Reference resolution [width, height] (default [1920, 1080]) |
| `sortOrder` | `int` | no | `0` | Sort order, when several canvases overlap |

```json
{ "name": "PauseMenu", "elements": ["text:Paused", "button:Resume", "button:Quit"] }
```

### `ui.layoutReport`

Geometric UI problems on a canvas: off-screen rects, zero-size elements, overlapping siblings, low-contrast text, unsafe-area content.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `canvas` | `string` | no | `null` | Canvas name or path. Defaults to every canvas in the open scenes. |
| `checks` | `string[]` | no | `null` | Which checks: offscreen, zerosize, overlap, contrast, safearea. Default all. |
| `safeAreaInset` | `float` | no | `0f` | Safe-area inset in pixels to assume, for notch devices (default 0) |
| `limit` | `int` | no | `50` | Maximum findings (default 50) |

```json
{ }
```

```json
{ "canvas": "HUD", "checks": ["offscreen", "contrast"] }
```
